details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh:155-267 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the first Contents API PUT returns 422 because the branch is missing, and a concurrent intake creates `ai/alert-inbox` before `_alert_inbox_ensure_branch` checks it, the early `ref_get=200` `return 0` path leaves `BRANCH_CREATED=0`, so the retry gate `if [ "${BRANCH_CREATED}" -eq 1 ] || [ "${put_code}" = "404" ]` is false and the script exits with `_alert_inbox_fail "http_422"`.
  WHY: Every flagging reviewer rated this MAJOR. Intake runs are parallel (per-run concurrency groups), so during the first concurrent alert burst the runs that lose the bootstrap race drop their alert record permanently, even though the branch now exists. The `if: failure()` step then sends a Telegram CRITICAL, and `test_unexplained_422_with_existing_branch_fails` asserts this behavior. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 declined to report it as a finding because the code predates the last run and the race happens only once; it listed it under hardening instead.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Issue #9395 Scope item 1 — "`pipeline_self_files` (list from plan section 'Triage')", which the plan settles as bare workflow file names (e.g. `implement.yml`, `review_autofix.yml`, `clarify.yml`)
  expected_change_site: .github/ai/alert_inbox.json, `pipeline_self_files` (lines 3-20)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The delivered file uses repository paths (e.g. `.github/workflows/implement.yml`) instead of the bare names in docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md:309-315 / 310-315, the `break_glass_*` lists in the same file match the plan, commit 104b4ac documents the deviation as an assumption, the list is inert in Phase 1 but Phase 2 must reconcile the format (all four rated it NIT; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 judged it not a gap because full paths fit the plan's intersect-with-changed-files use)
- requirement: Create `.github/ai/alert_inbox.json` with the schema and content defined in Phase 1 of `docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md`.
  expected_change_site: .github/ai/alert_inbox.json
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The file is missing from the checkout, which is the root cause of the failing check-run `test_shipped_config_is_off` (rated BLOCKER; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 reports that commit 104b4ac adds the file and that it was checked from the diff, because the sandbox's .github/ai/ contains only claude_engine.json)
- requirement: Capture alerts at the source in `tg_send_msg`, with `alert_inbox_capture.sh` sourced relative to `tg_helpers.sh` and available in staged support environments.
  expected_change_site: `scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh` and `scripts/ai_engine.sh` support-staging lists
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: `scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh` stages `tg_helpers.sh` but not `alert_inbox_capture.sh`, and the optional support list in `scripts/ai_engine.sh` also omits it, so capture is off in staged callers (rated MAJOR; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash judged this an intentional deferral that the issue permits, outside the files_touched grant)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)
- HARDENING (not a finding): scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh | _alert_inbox_ensure_branch, the early "GET ref ... 200 -> return 0" branch, together with the retry condition after bootstrap in the PUT loop ("if [ "${BRANCH_CREATED}" -eq 1 ] || [ "${put_code}" = "404" ]")
  PROBLEM: A 422 first PUT followed by a concurrent branch creation returns 0 with BRANCH_CREATED=0, so the loop exits with http_422 and the record is not stored; this happens only during the one-time branch bootstrap.
  WHY: Suggested fix is to retry a 422 once when the PUT response .message matches "branch" and the branch now exists, capturing the message before the GET overwrites resp_file (4-6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- NOTE: The reviewer rejected three pass-1 items as findings or gaps: pipeline_self_files full paths, the staging-list gap, and the 422 race (moved to hardening). It verified that commit 104b4ac (.github/ai/alert_inbox.json) closes the Scope item 1 gap.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh:_alert_inbox_ensure_branch (lines 176-209) and the retry loop (lines 250-267) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The intake fails on a concurrent first-time branch creation when the first PUT returns 422.
  WHY: ensure_branch sees the branch and returns success with `BRANCH_CREATED` still 0, and the retry check `[ "${BRANCH_CREATED}" -eq 1 ] || [ "${put_code}" = "404" ]` is false for 422, so the run exits with `http_422` and rejects the alert.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Create `.github/ai/alert_inbox.json` with the schema and content defined in Phase 1 of `docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md`.
  Expected change site: `.github/ai/alert_inbox.json`
  Evidence of absence: The file is missing from the checkout; this causes the failing check-run `test_shipped_config_is_off` and prevents merge.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Capture alerts at the source in `tg_send_msg`, with `alert_inbox_capture.sh` sourced relative to `tg_helpers.sh` and available in staged support environments.
  Expected change site: `scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh` and `scripts/ai_engine.sh` support-staging lists
  Evidence of absence: Neither list includes `alert_inbox_capture.sh`, so `tg_send_msg` leaves capture off in staged environments.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: `pipeline_self_files` must use bare file names as defined in the plan (docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md:310-315).
  Expected change site: `.github/ai/alert_inbox.json`, `pipeline_self_files` (lines 3-20)
  Evidence of absence: The file uses repository paths (e.g. `.github/workflows/implement.yml`) instead of bare names (e.g. `implement.yml`).
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh:lines 242-265 (the while-loop `404|422)` case and the retry condition `if [ "${BRANCH_CREATED}" -eq 1 ] || [ "${put_code}" = "404" ]; then continue`); lines 191-220 (`_alert_inbox_ensure_branch`); ~lines 259-263 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4 (3 related items)
  PROBLEM: When the first PUT returns 422 and a concurrent run creates `ai/alert-inbox`, ensure_branch returns through the `ref_get=200` early path without setting BRANCH_CREATED=1. The retry guard then fails and the script calls `_alert_inbox_fail "http_${put_code}"`. The function cannot tell "we just made it" from "lost the race", and a storable 422 is treated as fatal.
  WHY: On the first concurrent burst against an empty repo, every run that loses the bootstrap race loses its alert permanently. The `if: failure()` step then sends a Telegram CRITICAL through `tg_send_msg_direct`. `tests/test_alert_inbox_store.py::test_unexplained_422_with_existing_branch_fails` locks in the behavior, and the run cannot recover because retries are bounded.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Issue #9395 Scope item 1 — `pipeline_self_files` "(list from plan section 'Triage')", which the plan describes as bare workflow file names (e.g. `implement.yml`, `review_autofix.yml`, `clarify.yml`).
  Expected change site: .github/ai/alert_inbox.json lines 3-20, the `pipeline_self_files` array.
  Evidence of absence: The committed file uses full `.github/workflows/<name>.yml` paths for ten entries. Commit 104b4ac documents the deviation. The list is inert in Phase 1, but Phase 2 must reconcile the format.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- NOTE: The reviewer did not report the staging-list gap. The issue says a missing capture script means "treat capture as failed or off, so the alert still goes to Telegram", and the agents fragment documents the deferral.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh:`_alert_inbox_ensure_branch()` lines 176-178 and the retry condition at lines 257-261 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the first PUT returns 422 and another intake creates the branch before `_alert_inbox_ensure_branch()` checks it, the function returns success without setting `BRANCH_CREATED`, and the caller does not retry because `put_code` is 422.
  WHY: The workflow concurrency group is unique per run, so concurrent first-time runs reach this path, fail with `http_422`, and do not store the record.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Add `pipeline_self_files` using the list from the plan's "Triage" section.
  Expected change site: `.github/ai/alert_inbox.json`, `pipeline_self_files`
  Evidence of absence: The plan lists names without directory prefixes (`docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md`, lines 309-315). The config uses `.github/workflows/implement.yml` and `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` (lines 5-14).
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh:`_alert_inbox_ensure_branch` lines 155-158 (ref_get 200 early `return 0` without setting `BRANCH_CREATED`) and the retry gate at line 257 (`if [ "${BRANCH_CREATED}" -eq 1 ] || [ "${put_code}" = "404" ]; then continue; fi`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A first-PUT 422 followed by a concurrent branch creation takes the early-return path with `BRANCH_CREATED=0`, so the call falls through to `_alert_inbox_fail "http_422"` at line 261 even though the branch exists.
  WHY: Intake runs are parallel, so the record is lost permanently. This contradicts the contract that the `refs` 422 case honors at lines 207-210. The path is reachable: line 242 handles `404|422)`, and the test `test_missing_branch_is_bootstrapped_from_an_empty_root_commit` parametrizes `[404, 422]`. Suggested fix is to set `BRANCH_CREATED=1` (or `BRANCH_EXISTS=1`) in the ref_get 200 branch and check it at line 257 (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3, estimated 3 lines).
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Issue #9395 Scope item 1 — "`pipeline_self_files` (list from plan section 'Triage')", which the plan (docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md:310-315) settles as bare workflow file names.
  Expected change site: .github/ai/alert_inbox.json, `pipeline_self_files` (lines 3-20).
  Evidence of absence: Ten workflow entries are written as `.github/workflows/...` paths, while the break-glass lists match the plan. Commit 104b4ac documents the deviation. The list is inert in Phase 1, but Phase 2 must reconcile the format.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- NOTE: The reviewer did not report the staging-list gap for `scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh` / `scripts/ai_engine.sh`. The issue tolerates a missing helper, the files_touched grant excludes both files, both switches ship `false`, and the agents fragment documents staging as a later-phase step.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
